1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 b6 4.Bg2 Bb7 5.O-O.strategy: Completes the kingside set-up: the king is safe behind the fianchettoed bishop and the rook is ready to back a later central advance. White plays for a long positional game against a Black centre that has no pawn break ready.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 b6 4.Bg2 Bb7 5.O-O.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Catalan Defence
